source.intersection: Lankershim Boulevard at Main Street/MTA Driveway
source.metadata_scope: FHWA says first trajectory dataset starts at 08:27:34 in the RSM report; source video clock alignment and lamp states are separate questions.

cycle_timestamp_evidence.interpretation: Each timestamp marks the end of that row's reported cycle. This follows from variable-length cycles as well as the FHWA description of cycle-by-cycle green splits.

at_v7_full_video_1hz.interpretation: ATLAS 7 uses the preceding completed cycle's row as if it begins the current cycle. Row disagreement does not prove a lamp-state disagreement at every second.

controller_phase_evidence.source_type: Controller-reported green splits, not recorded phase-transition events or independently observed lamps
controller_phase_evidence.timing_sheet_date: 2002-05-13; available historical plan, not proof it remained unchanged in 2005

blocking_unknowns: Exact within-cycle phase onset, order, yellow/clearance and pedestrian calls cannot be recovered from split totals alone.
The RSM row correction must be tested as an assumption-labeled simulation ablation, not called observed lamp timing.
The 2002 timing sheet and 2005 RSM do not by themselves establish visible 2005 lamp states at the camera.
